faults.page says: The Herita page says only that Herita has worked with Stad Antwerpen since 2024 to open the house to the public and is studying restoration needs; it does not say Herita owns or runs the Braemhuis. KBO 0454.452.225 describes Herita as a Vereniging zonder winstoogmerk and contracting authority, which is a fact about Herita, not about the house. This is the inference the first-pass checker already rejected, and no cited page states the missing owner or operator link.
